_comment: Read by core helpers/stop-dispatcher.cjs: which Stop checks run, and how each finding reads in ONE line. Each template is a plain sentence for the human who reads the feedback too — no ids, commands or arrows; the agent finds details in the hook's own header. An extract that does not match passes the full text through (nothing is swallowed). Labels and templates are instance language: translate them, keep marker and cmd. mode record = never blocks, writes .claude-state/<marker>.jsonl.

checks.label: UNFINISHED
checks.extract: markers in code written this turn:\s*([^\n]+)

checks.label: SAME BUG ELSEWHERE
checks.template: {1} changed - does the same defect exist anywhere else?

checks.label: CLOSING QUESTION
checks.template: Closing question "{1}" - keep it only if the operator alone can decide it

checks.label: OPEN ITEMS
checks.template: The open items from the session start are missing from the first reply

checks.label: WATCHER
checks.template: A reaction is expected, but no watcher is running

checks.label: QUESTIONS
checks.template: {1} question(s) to the operator still unsettled, e.g. "{2}"
